Resolves #21453

🌿 *Row 1 can no longer blame a contributor's diff for a race in the engine.*

Row 1 stops asserting on the main window after the drop. That arm, added by #21380, reads a real engine race (#21455): in some runs the Grid pane returns to the main window shortly after pointer-up while its popup stays open, and the chart-text check then reads the three-pane layout, where the bar chart cuts its own axis title. The arm returns with #21455's AC-3; the popup's moments stay.

Evidence: L3 (the spec runs in CI wherever `e2e-engine` selects it; local repeat runs) → L3 required (AC-1, AC-2). Residual: none.

## AC Evidence

| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | CI-covered: row 1 in `test/playwright/e2e/colors/tearOutMatrix.spec.mjs` ends with the popup's `expectContentFillsWindow`; its `readUnion`, `expectPanesRefill` and page-level `expectChartTextInside` calls are gone. |
| AC-2 | Outside-CI: `npx playwright test -c test/playwright/playwright.config.e2e.mjs --workers=1 test/playwright/e2e/colors/tearOutMatrix.spec.mjs --repeat-each=10 --retries=0` at b187300d73: rows 1 to 3 passed 10 of 10 (30 passed; rows 4, 6 and 7 are `test.fixme`). |

## Deltas from ticket

None substantive.

## Test Evidence

- On `dev` 87e0ae1bc4, row 1 passed 10 of 10 local runs. With the release moved outside the window (the ticket's first fix, dropped), 1 of 10 failed the same way, and its trace shows the pane's slot restored before the release.
- CI's failing job on #21445 (135375311683) and its green rerun (135393511768) log the same crossing receipt, `acquiredAtStep: 8`.
